verdict.rationale: Databricks' own metric-views documentation says users can query metric views from Power BI, Tableau, Sigma and other external BI tools, which is a first-party BI-tool integration claim. The evidence never documents JDBC/ODBC drivers themselves: Databricks Connect is only described as working 'just like a JDBC driver', which is a developer library, not a standard driver. Missing for 10: documented JDBC/ODBC drivers, BI connection setup guides beyond the single metric-views mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration that dashboards connect without custom glue.
